description: Contract schema for Mythos radioactive chunks. Every chunk follows this structure.

chunk_contract.name: Human readable name
chunk_contract.type: db_query | text_search | format_summary | route_intent | date_filter | rank_results | db_write | compose
chunk_contract.description: What this chunk does in one sentence

db_query.description: Reads from PostgreSQL, returns structured rows + summary

text_search.description: Full-text search against PostgreSQL tsvector or ILIKE

format_summary.description: Takes structured data, produces natural language summary

route_intent.description: Analyzes a message, determines which chunks/stores to query

date_filter.description: Extracts date references from natural language, builds SQL WHERE

rank_results.description: Scores and sorts results by relevance, recency, or custom criteria

compose.description: Chains multiple chunks, passes output forward
